newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pakistan spot fuel oil tender sees only one offer.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan spot fuel oil tender sees only one offer.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources received only one offer in its spot emergency tender to buy fuel oil for end-March delivery, a ministry source said.
The tender, which closed on February 17, sought 50,000 tonnes of 125-centistoke grade fuel oil with a 1.0-percent sulphur content, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keamari.

The sole offer, which was made by MidEast trader Bakri Trading, was "very much higher than the last awarded tender and the offer price was the highest that Pakistan has received in one and a half years."
In its last spot fuel oil tender for November delivery, Pakistan bought at a premium of $22.99 per tonne to MidEast spot quotes, c-and-f Keamari.
The source said the lack of offers and the high price could be due to the short notice for the tender and the lack of available supplies for the required fuel oil grade.
